Name: Content_Patcher-CarbuncleCatReplacement
Author: timstapl
Description:
[size=5]Carbuncle Cat Replacement[/size]

This is a port of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9323942]Vinchon[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/303]Carbuncle Cat Replacement[/url] to Content Patcher, posted with their consent.
[size=4]
Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Download the .rar archive either from [url=https://github.com/retrocede/StardewValleyMods/releases/download/v0.1/CP.carbuncle.cat.rar]github[/url]﻿ or here.
[*]Extract, and copy the folder into your Mods directory.
[*]This mod required SMAPI and Content Patcher
[/list]
[size=4]Configuration[/size]
The first time you run Stardew Valley a config.json will be created. By default the Blue carbuncle will be selected; you can edit config.json for other colors.

Example config.json:[code]
{
  "Color": "blue"
}[/code]
[i]valid colors are blue, yellow, or gray[/i]
[code]﻿[/code]
